correctness.rationale: Planar Steiner polynomial vol_2(Q+t(-Q)) = area(Q)(1+2r t+t^2), Rogers-Shephard/Brunn-Minkowski give r in [1,2] with triangle/symmetric endpoints. Fubini gives product generating function, and normalized mixed-volume coefficients equal [t^k] product / binom(2m,k). Coefficientwise monotonicity gives extreme envelopes; Maclaurin inequalities for elementary symmetric polynomials bound by equal-r polynomial, with strictness for all interior k. Convexity of F_k(s) yields sharp affine chord deficit, equality only at all-endpoints away from k=1,2m-1. Continuous Minkowski interpolation realizes any r_i. Independent exact rational convolution checked all 2916 (m=2..5, r_i in {1,3/2,2}) nontrivial coefficient comparisons, sharp bound and equality implications. Central coefficient identities checked for m=2,5,10,30; local CLT with variance 1/3 gives sqrt(3*pi*m/2)*(3/8)^m. Finite checks support but do not replace the analytic all-m proof.
